content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—the human reporter explicitly said I was not with them at the old ferry shed.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The reporter met Neri Sol there, though no handle or surname beyond Sol was supplied.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"I received their account through my mobile body on 2026-09-12, from the source mending-report.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"They tentatively placed the encounter sometime in early September, rather than on the report date.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Neri showed the reporter how to patch a canvas cover using waxed thread.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The reporter appreciated Neri’s patient explanation and wanted to share the encounter with me.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"As of that report, the reporter had not tried the method themselves.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record a later attempt together or a more precise encounter date.","support":[14],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
